Bound byte/count/depth and use immutable source/attempt bindings; missing evidence remains unknown.
Diagnostic failures cannot change exception propagation, source checks, settlement, retries or custody cleanup.

observed_test_gaps: Signed native positive replaces llm_router.generate_text and times out a single leaf process; no real shared Grok adapter or grandchildren are exercised.
Partial edits and pool cases currently use the embedded legacy database fixture, while signed native positive covers no-write only.
Detached survivor unit test injects an issued native tuple; it does not traverse runner, shared adapter, lifecycle finalization and durable callback state.
Late STOP after an unresolved callback lacks a focused regression proving process cleanup cannot retroactively settle or retry.
preserved_authority_requirements: Only the exact native Portal daemon with captured actual Popen may issue one-use exit custody.
Native child must have returned normally through outer process supervision with a waited nonzero status; inner TimeoutExpired metadata does not establish this.
Exact source/claim/admission/fence, finalized captured lifecycle, durable state/event/projection joins and callback-intent CAS remain necessary.
Failure settlement blocks the task and releases the claim without task completion, source publication or automatic retry.
Missing native receipt remains started_outcome_unknown even after unrelated STOP/close proves process cleanup.
